g.text: What the semantic GSU finds that the ID-based GSU does not
Exclusive rate: share of retrieved history items that QARM V2 finds and the baseline GSU (SIM) does not.
e.g. jewellery for a phone-accessory target
retrieved items stay in the target's
category and meaning; often related but
Also: sequences are not deduplicated. In live streaming the top-100 interactions contain only 23 unique authors
